title: 57-family AML to sixteen-harness remapping
assumption: All recommended feature refinements, evidence/scoring corrections and sixteen additions in issue #1047 are implemented by agent-hook. This is the requested analytical assumption, not an implementation or deployment attestation.

input_authority.feature_definitions: 41 refined legacy families plus the 16 named additions in the issue; names are the proposed refined claim labels, with original names retained.
input_authority.taxonomy_check: All sixteen harness specifications and taxonomy read locally matched remote blobs at the pinned commit.

mandatory_control_semantics: Required-control satisfaction is orthogonal to diagnostic weighting; zero weight, absent/unknown evidence or score rounding cannot establish satisfaction.
maturity_stage_semantics: This remap does not assume adoption of optional replacement M1-M5 labels. Use the implemented versioned AML stage semantics, profile policy and evidence gates; stages are not assigned wholesale to harnesses.
mapping_rules: Exactly one family-level primary accountable harness; multiple implementation/control/evidence participants.
Atomic obligations may have different owners from their family coordinator; each listed obligation has one owner.
The family primary partition is MECE over 57 families; architecture participation is many-to-many.
Selected profiles determine applicable criteria; 57 is a library, not a mandatory installation or assessment checklist.
One atomic control result is reused by reference, never duplicated as score credit across family or harness views.
Harness/source readiness, deployment, runtime, assurance and tenant acceptance remain separate.
